Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECONSENT AND DE-IDENTIFICATION :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient and the attenders have been adequately informed about this documentation and privacy of the patient is being entirely conserved. No identifiers shall be revealed through out the piece of work whatsoever.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:\u003Cdiv\u003E1. Pain abdomen since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. Fever since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient came to the casualty with complains of pain abdomen since five days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 2 years back when she had white discharge PV for which she took medication but it did not resolve. She had a surgery (hysterectomy) for the same on April 26 2023.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince then the patient was having on and off episodes of pain abdomen which was of squeezing type and diffuse. It was relieved on taking medication (unknown)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince five days, the intensity of pain has increased. The pain in the hypogastric region and is of squeezing type. She also complains of pain in the left lower back region which is of squeezing type and radiates towards the groin.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIt is associated with vomitings (2 to 3 episodes per day, non-projectile, non-bilious, watery with food particles as contents.)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient also complains of fever on and off since two months which is of low grade, intermittent and is associated with chills and rigours and reduced on taking medication (paracetamol 650mg PO\/BD)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient complains of burning micturition since 2 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Complains of decreased urine output.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Patient was diagnosed with DM2 four days back and not put on any medication\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Not a known case of HYPERTENSION, TUBERCULOSIS, CVA, CAD, THYROID DISORDERS, BRONCHIAL ASTHMA.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt undergone hysterectomy in the month of April.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECONSENT AND DE-IDENTIFICATION :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient and the attenders have been adequately informed about this documentation and privacy of the patient is being entirely conserved. No identifiers shall be revealed through out the piece of work whatsoever.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient came to the casuality with chief complaints of abdominal pain since 5 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 days back then he developed pain in the abdomen more in the epigastric region , burning type , with no radiation ,Aggravated with food intake and relieved on taking medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHad similar complaints 1 year back - went to the hospital with abdominal pain and was diagnosed as jaundice for which he was treated.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDAILY ROUTINE:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe wakes up at 6 am and gets freshened up. Drinks tea at 7 am followed by breakfast ( rice with curry) at 9 am. Leaves home for work( works as Shepard) at 9am and works till 7 pm. In between eats lunch at 2 pm and drinks tea at 5 pm. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECONSENT AND DE-IDENTIFICATION :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient and the attenders have been adequately informed about this documentation and privacy of the patient is being entirely conserved. No identifiers shall be revealed through out the piece of work whatsoever.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt c\/o Unresponsiveness since 5 am on 18\/6\/ 23\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 10 years ago\u0026nbsp; went to hospital for routine checkup and was diagnosed with DM type 2 ,since then he was on tab.Glimi M1 500 mg Po\/Od.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient complains of decreased appetite since 6 months .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was alright 1 week ago,pt came to casualty with a Hypoglycemic episode ( Giddiness) managed conservatively and not willing for admission at that time.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was alright for 1 week bought to casualty,his Grbs at presentation was 35 mg\/dl.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter starting 25 D 100 mlIv\/Stat,then Grbs was 168 mg\/dl,pt became responsive.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/o Burning micturition since 4 days .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo c\/o fever,cold,cough, vomiting,loose stools\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo c\/o Sob,chestpain, palpitations,orthopnea,PND .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo c\/o pedal edema, Facial puffiness, decreased urine output.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 20\/6\/23 pt had fever spikes (103.F ) high grade , intermittent,not associated with chills and rigor.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/o Vomitings 2 episodes food as content,non projectile,non bilious.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/o loose stools 4 episodes\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPast History:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOperated for cataract 20 years ago.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal History:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite - decreased\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet-mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep- adequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movement - Regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions- 5-6 cigarettes\/day since 20 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOccasional alcoholic since 20years.
